# When must your business send and receive e-invoices?

> Free EU e-invoicing mandate checker: when your business must receive and issue structured e-invoices in Germany, France, Belgium, Poland, Italy, Croatia, Greece or Spain, in what format, and whether PDF is still enough. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
